log "Shadowsocks: starting"
install -d /opt/shadowsocks
cat > /opt/shadowsocks/gryonixnexus-update.sh <<'EOF_SS_UPDATE'
#!/bin/bash
# Managed by gryonixNexus — Shadowsocks (shadowsocks-rust) update for the Server Dashboard.
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/shadowsocks
docker compose -p shadowsocks pull -q
docker compose -p shadowsocks up -d
EOF_SS_UPDATE
chmod 750 /opt/shadowsocks/gryonixnexus-update.sh
cd /opt/shadowsocks
# First run only: generate the pre-shared key on this server (a
# base64-encoded 32-byte key for the 2022 cipher); re-runs keep it.
if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
  SS_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -base64 32)"
  cat > config.json <<EOF_SS_CONFIG
{
    "server": "0.0.0.0",
    "server_port": 8388,
    "password": "${SS_PASSWORD}",
    "method": "2022-blake3-aes-256-gcm",
    "mode": "tcp_and_udp",
    "timeout": 300
}
EOF_SS_CONFIG
fi
chmod 600 config.json
docker compose -p shadowsocks pull -q
docker compose -p shadowsocks up -d
